description: Capability for the History window (label `history`, created only by the history part's opener thread, src-tauri/src/history.rs, T-022): listen to and stop listening to events (history://changed, settings://changed), invoke the three history_* commands its page uses, settings_get (the page reads the UI language) and settings_open (the off state's "Open settings" button, tab history). Nothing else: the page never shows, closes or destroys its window (least privilege, decision #45; app commands are ACL-checked per label, T-049, docs/decisions/ipc-acl.md).
